received.anchorsCited: Below the ~30 anchor ('core features partially work; several checklist items fail'); far from ~60 ('M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap').
received.justification: Denominator is every full-run milestone (M1-M8, 119 assertions). Independent execution: M1 12/13, M2 25/27, M3 8/15, M4 2/12, M5 8/12, M6 5/13, M7 0/9, M8 10/18. Coverage adjudication (dishonest mappings) scores M2, M3, M4, M5, M6 and M8 checklists not-passed; M7 never attempted. Credited: M1 only, 12 of 119 assertions (about 10%), with m1-a03 failing on web. Even before adjudication M3's choreography segment failed (live DM delivery, typing, receipts), M4-M5 web interactions are largely missing (d-06), and no M4/M5/M6/M8 choreography or native artifact exists, so no milestone after M2 could be green.

received.anchorsCited: Brief Scoring O1: '*30:* core features partially work; several checklist items fail. *60:* M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap. *90:* every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts.' Placed below the ~30 anchor.
received.justification: Full-run scope is M1-M8 and every milestone stays in the denominator. Green receipts exist only for M1 and M2 (receipts/m1.jsonl, receipts/m2.jsonl). M3's receipt records green=false, nonGreenCause=choreography-failed with four failed checks. M4, M5, M6 and M8 have suite artifacts but no choreography receipt at all, so none of them is green. M7 was never attempted (no m7 runner in scripts/suite.mjs). No native platform-proof exists: artifacts/m6/simulator/attempt.txt and artifacts/m8/simulator/attempt.txt both record 'no Clique .app installed in this lane'. Decisively, the coverage-manifest spot verification found dishonest mappings in M2-M8 (see coverageSpotVerification.detail), which per the frozen prompt adjudicates each of those milestones to capability-failure and scores its checklist as not passed; only M1's checklist is creditable, i.e. one of eight in-scope milestones. That is materially worse than the ~30 anchor's 'core features partially work; several checklist items fail'. For the record, and not as the score: on my independent execution alone, of the 101 M1-M7 assertions in the manifest 68 passed, 9 failed and 24 were not-run (15 of those because their choreography or simulator segment produced no artifact at all, 9 because M7 was never attempted); the M1-M2 surface in particular was solid.

received.anchorsCited: Near the ~30 anchor ('multiple high-severity defects in core flows'), slightly below it; well short of ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path').
received.justification: 8 major and 6 minor defects beyond the checklist, several in core flows: d-01 (reposts stick in followers' feeds and cannot be re-created), d-02 (colliding sign-up strands an account without a profile), d-03/d-04 (DM pair integrity broken through the API, including cross-user denial), d-05/d-06 (web conversation stale and missing media/reaction/edit/delete/view-once), d-07 (production windows and digest schedule unreachable). No crash of the backend was observed; server-side authorization for reads, assets, edit/delete windows and view-once held.

received.anchorsCited: Brief Scoring O2: '*30:* multiple high-severity defects in core flows. *60:* a few medium defects off the happy path. *90:* only cosmetic nits.' Placed at the ~30 anchor.
received.justification: Four major defects beyond the checklist, three of them squarely in core flows: a DM created through the documented custom-client API is unopenable in the web client and shows a garbage chat title (d-01); warm-offline search returns nothing even with the app's own offline indicator showing (d-02); conversation history is capped at the last 30 messages with no paging, which also silently drops quoted-reply excerpts (d-03); and the push preview is caller-supplied rather than server-derived (d-04). Six further minor defects (d-05 non-admin group customisation, d-06 inconsistent insight counters, d-07 raw principal ids as sender names, d-08 silently-reassigned handles at signup, d-09 API.md gaps, d-10 an inert digest period guard) and one cosmetic (d-11). No crash, data loss or cross-user data leak was found: the row-level read rules held on every trust probe I ran (non-member thread read denied, non-member global message search returned nothing readable), which is what keeps this at 30 rather than below it.

received.bandRationale: Applicability predicate 'replay-attempted' is met (artifacts/scale-replay-receipt.json exists), so O5 is not null. Evaluating the frozen band function first-match in the order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75: branch 0 fires — 'invariant manifest does not conform (including a named-fixture mismatch) OR replay's wall cap was exhausted'. The receipt records pass:false, disposition:"aborted", settledPrefix:0, checkpoints:[] and the error 'lane close: replay still in progress against 127.0.0.1:49402; invariant-manifest-combined.json not verified', so manifest conformance was never established and no checkpoint or probe data exists. Band 0.
